# Output Format Reference

`handover` generates two files: `CLAUDE.md` and `PLAN.md`. This document describes their format and the data model behind them.

---

## CLAUDE.md

Auto-ingested by Claude Code at session start. Contains all context a terminal agent needs to continue work without re-explanation.

### Structure

```markdown
# Project: <goal>
<!-- Generated by handover v0.1.0 from Claude chat on <date> -->

## Tech Stack
- Language: <language>
- Framework: <framework>
- Database: <database>
- ...

## Key Decisions
- <decision> (rationale: <rationale>)
- ...

## Constraints
- <constraint>
- ...

## Non-Goals
- <non-goal>
- ...

## Open Questions
- [ ] <question>
- ...

## Handover Source
- Chat title: <title>
- Exported: <ISO timestamp>
```

### Field Descriptions

| Field | Source | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| `Project` | `HandoverContext.goal` | Single-sentence project goal |
| `Tech Stack` | `HandoverContext.tech_stack` | Key-value pairs |
| `Key Decisions` | `HandoverContext.decisions` | Each `Decision` has topic, decision, rationale |
| `Constraints` | `HandoverContext.constraints` | Hard requirements |
| `Non-Goals` | `HandoverContext.non_goals` | Explicitly out of scope |
| `Open Questions` | `HandoverContext.open_questions` | Unresolved items |

---

## PLAN.md

Task checklist for Claude Code. Formatted as GitHub Flavored Markdown checkboxes so Claude Code can track progress.

### Structure

```markdown
# Implementation Plan
<!-- Generated by handover v0.1.0 -->

## Tasks
- [ ] <task title>
  <optional description>
- [ ] ...

## Open Questions to Resolve First
- [ ] <question>
```

### Field Descriptions

| Field | Source | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| `Tasks` | `HandoverContext.tasks` | Each `Task` has title, description, priority, done flag |
| `Open Questions` | `HandoverContext.open_questions` | Duplicated from CLAUDE.md for easy access |

---

## HandoverContext Data Model

```python
@dataclass
class HandoverContext:
    schema_version: str          # e.g. "1.0" — bump when schema changes
    source: str                  # "claude" | "chatgpt" | ...
    source_version: str          # export format version detected
    conversation_title: str
    conversation_id: str | None
    extracted_at: str            # ISO timestamp
    goal: str
    tech_stack: dict             # {"language": "Python", "framework": "FastAPI", ...}
    decisions: list[Decision]
    tasks: list[Task]
    constraints: list[str]
    non_goals: list[str]
    open_questions: list[str]

@dataclass
class Decision:
    topic: str
    decision: str
    rationale: str

@dataclass
class Task:
    title: str
    description: str
    priority: str               # "high" | "medium" | "low"
    done: bool
```

### Schema Versioning

`schema_version` is bumped whenever `HandoverContext` fields change in a breaking way. Parser implementations may set `source_version` to indicate which variant of a source's export format they detected. This allows future tooling to route files to the correct parser without user-visible breakage.

---

## Customizing Templates

The output is generated from Jinja2 templates. Run `handover init` to copy the defaults to `~/.handover/templates/` and edit them freely. Pass `--template ~/.handover/templates/` to use your custom versions.
